task_instance: Prepare a client review one-pager for a sample household (Robert & Susan Miller, 3 accounts, $1.65M AUM): compute portfolio vs. benchmark performance (QTD/YTD/1Y/3Y/SI) and alpha, compute current-vs-target allocation drift against a 5% IPS rebalancing threshold and flag breaches, generate an allocation pie chart (target vs current), and assemble a one-page meeting-ready summary with performance table, attribution, allocation table, meeting agenda, proactive recommendations, and outstanding action items.
blocker_detail: Minor/secondary limitation only (did not block the core deliverable): the skill's Step 6 output format is listed as 'Word or PDF'. No PDF/DOCX generation library is installed (python-docx, reportlab, weasyprint, fpdf, pdfkit all absent), and the one document-conversion program present, LibreOffice (soffice), is non-functional in this sandbox -- it fails to load even a trivial one-line .txt or a bundled sample .odt ('Error: source file could not be loaded') regardless of working directory or a fresh profile. /usr/bin/chromium-browser is only a snap stub ('requires the chromium snap to be installed') and cannot render to PDF either. The full analytical deliverable (performance/alpha table, attribution, allocation drift/rebalance flags, chart, agenda, recommendations, action items) was produced and verified as an HTML document with an embedded PNG chart, which fulfills the skill's core described intent ('pulls together account data into a concise meeting-ready format'); only the specific binary output format (PDF/Word) could not be produced given the broken/missing local tooling.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/anthropics__financial-services-plugins__client-review@offline-workstation . Created client_data.json (sample household: accounts, IPS target allocation, performance vs benchmark by period, current allocation, attribution, action items). Wrote build_review.py which: computes alpha per period, computes allocation drift vs 5% threshold and flags REBALANCE (US Large Cap +7.0pp, Fixed Income -6.0pp correctly flagged; other asset classes correctly held), renders a target-vs-current allocation pie chart to allocation_chart.png (verified via `file` = valid 1200x600 PNG), and assembles client_review_summary.html (one-page summary: performance table with alpha, top contributors/detractors, allocation table with drift/action column, embedded chart image, meeting agenda per skill Step 4, proactive recommendations per skill Step 5 driven by the actual drift/performance numbers, and outstanding action items). Ran `python3 build_review.py` (exit 0) and verified output content programmatically (assert 'REBALANCE' in html, 'Alpha' in html, chart reference present; grep confirmed 2 REBALANCE rows) and by inspecting the full rendered HTML (cat client_review_summary.html), confirming correct arithmetic (e.g. Alpha 1-Year = 14.2-15.0 = -0.8%, Fixed Income drift 24-30 = -6.0pp -> REBALANCE). Attempted PDF export via `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` (multiple variants: default profile, -env:UserInstallation to fresh profiles, different working directories, and against a minimal .txt and a bundled LibreOffice sample .odt) -- all failed identically with 'Error: source file could not be loaded', confirming the installed LibreOffice is non-functional for conversion in this sandbox, not a fluke of the specific HTML file. Also checked for python-docx, reportlab, weasyprint, fpdf, xhtml2pdf, pdfkit (all ModuleNotFoundError) and chromium-browser --headless --print-to-pdf (fails: 'requires the chromium snap to be installed'). No network access was used or required for any of this.
